Page 691 
Furosemide injection products 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-700352  
Guideline Name 
Furosemide injection products  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Furoscix, Furoscix ReadyFlow  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting diagnosis of one of the 
following:  
• 
chronic heart failure  
• 
chronic kidney disease  


=== PDF PAGE 692 ===
Page 692 
 
AND 
 
2 - Drug will be used for the treatment of edema  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient weighs at least 43 kg  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient is currently on maintenance oral diuretic therapy (e.g., bumetanide, furosemide, 
torsemide)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Provider attests that patient will be closely monitored for fluid, electrolyte, and metabolic 
abnormalities throughout therapy (e.g., hypokalemia, hypovolemia, hyponatremia)  
 
AND 
 
6 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting one of the 
following:  
 
 6.1 History of failure to intravenous furosemide (Lasix IV)  
 
OR 
 
 6.2 Provider has submitted clinical rationale for why intravenous furosemide is inappropriate  
 
Product Name:Lasix Onyu  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


=== PDF PAGE 693 ===
Page 693 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting diagnosis of chronic heart 
failure  
 
AND 
 
2 - Drug will be used for the treatment of edema  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is currently on maintenance oral diuretic therapy (e.g., bumetanide, furosemide, 
torsemide)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Provider attests that patient will be closely monitored for fluid, electrolyte, and metabolic 
abnormalities throughout therapy (e.g., hypokalemia, hypovolemia, hyponatremia)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting one of the 
following:  
 
 5.1 History of failure to intravenous furosemide (Lasix IV)  
 
OR 
 
 5.2 Provider has submitted clinical rationale for why intravenous furosemide is inappropriate
